plan.title: Material PR to Reverse Auction Split Award and PO

steps.note: Set the required event title before publishing.

args.goal: on the buyer create screen, add exactly one Required T&C clause and set the schedule to a 30-minute event with a 30-minute evaluation period; stop when the saved create screen shows those settings

steps.note: No catalog step directly adds a required T&C clause or configures the separate evaluation duration.
Invite exactly two QA test vendors without inventing supplier names.
Commit the supported 30-minute event schedule before publishing.
Publish the PR-derived auction.
Confirm the event reached a real published project page.
Submit Vendor A's quote at 100 through the vendor portal.
Confirm the first vendor bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's lower quote at 90 through the second vendor portal session.
Confirm the second vendor bid was accepted.
Wait for the bidding window to end before reading QCS or awarding.
Open the buyer comparison grid after bidding closes.
Verify the lower bid ranks first, which should make Vendor B rank 1.
Enter the awarding screen to perform the requested split allocation as far as the catalog allows.
Allocate an award share to the first eligible vendor.
Attempt the second vendor allocation; the catalog cannot specify the requested 6/4 quantities or named role mapping.
Confirm the awarding screen counters reflect the allocations made.
Create and submit the award proposal from the awarding flow.
Confirm the award proposal was created and submitted.
Approve the submitted proposal with the required remark.
Complete approval and create the resulting purchase orders.
Check for two PO lines as the closest supported assertion of the intended two-vendor award result.
Return to the events list to verify the event's history placement.
Open the History tab after the event has completed.
Confirm this plan's event appears in event history.
